notes.title: L33na: The neon hunt continues — join the race for LokVyr’s fragments!
notes.content: [p]L33na throws you into a world where survival depends on sharp wits and quicker reflexes. Track down ancient fragments hidden by LokVyr and outsmart rival gangs in a dangerous broadcasted game. Choose your path carefully, or the Puritarchs’ spectacle will be your end.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Introducing L33na Redpepper – Add it to your Wishlist!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314208/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p]
